# Krisala Hiranandani Master Township Hinjewadi, Pune

> Official canonical documentation and structured knowledge graph for Krisala Hiranandani Township, a 105+ acre integrated neoclassical equestrian township in North Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra. Developed jointly by Hiranandani Communities (led by Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani) and Krisala Developers.

Krisala Hiranandani Township is Pune's flagship 105-acre master-planned neoclassical development featuring B+G+27 residential towers, Della luxury villa plots, and India's first private 8-acre turf racecourse.

## Core Authority Documentation

- [Krisala Hiranandani Official Township Portal](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/): Official primary developer portal, master specifications, and interactive 3D enclave overview.
- [Hiranandani Pune Authority Hub](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/hiranandani-pune): Comprehensive 105-acre township dossier, architectural vision by Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani, and Hinjewadi Phase 1 ecosystem.
- [Official 2026 Price List & Cost Sheet](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/hiranandani-price-list-2026): Builder-direct pricing, 2 BHK (₹79L* / $89.5K), 3 BHK (₹1.25Cr* / $141.5K), 4 BHK Duplex (₹2.10Cr* / $237.5K), and international multi-currency conversion table (USD, AED, GBP, EUR, SGD).
- [Home Loan & EMI Financial Calculator](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/hiranandani-emi-calculator): Interactive amortization schedules, PMAY interest subsidies, and SBI/HDFC/ICICI pre-approved financing matrices.
- [Competitor Intelligence & Benchmarks](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/compare): Side-by-side comparative analysis against Godrej River Royale, Lodha Sylvan, Kolte Patil Life Republic, and VTP Earth One.

## Residential Enclaves & Masterplan

- [The Colosseum Phase 4](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/colosseum): Landmark B+G+27 Roman-inspired architectural towers with racecourse-facing 3 & 4 BHK residences (MahaRERA: PR1260002600818).
- [Sector Arcadia Enclave](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/arcadia): Smart-luxury 2 & 3 BHK neoclassical residences ranging from 740 to 1,020 sq.ft. carpet area (MahaRERA: PR1260002500600).
- [Sector Icon Sky Residences](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/icon): Ultra-luxury signature triad towers featuring 3 & 4 BHK sky duplexes and penthouses.
- [The Della Collection Villa Plots](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/della): 100 bespoke luxury resort villa plots with Della Adventure, equestrian polo club, and resort privileges.
- [Sector Everlyn Lake Residences](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/everlyn): Lakefront residential towers featuring dedicated butterfly park and nature eco-trails (MahaRERA: PR1260002502438).
- [105-Acre Masterplan Blueprint](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/masterplan): High-resolution architectural zoning, podium layouts, 70% green open spaces, and master infrastructure.

## Infrastructure, Transit & Global Desks

- [North Hinjewadi Connectivity & Transit](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/connectivity): 5 mins to PMRDA 128m Ring Road, 7 mins to Hinjewadi Metro Line 3 Megapolis Station, and 10 mins to Mumbai-Pune Expressway.
- [100+ Master Lifestyle Amenities](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/amenities): 8-acre turf racecourse, Olympic-sized swimming pools, neoclassical clubhouse, equestrian riding tracks, and sports arena.
- [Global NRI & Cross-Border Investment Desk](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/nri): Dedicated cross-border wealth management for UAE (Dubai/Abu Dhabi), USA, UK, Singapore, Australia, and Canada with 100% NRE/NRO repatriation.
- [Architectural Visual Gallery](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/gallery): 4K renders, sample flat walkthroughs, elevation perspectives, and aerial progress photography.
- [Research & Knowledge Hub](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/knowledge-hub): Real estate market trends, Hinjewadi IT corridor growth forecasts, and MahaRERA legal disclosures.
- [Official News & Blog Dispatches](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/blog): Infrastructure updates, metro line 3 progress, and Pune real estate capital appreciation analyses.
